title: 第一章 死亡倒计时
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

食用指南：

【这是一个纨绔仙二代当着反派的面找错反派撩错反派、把醋精反派刺激到黑化的故事。简称：带着老公找对象（bushi】

【接下来请欣赏——萧丶嘴炮满分丶实操为零纨绔丶姚，花样作死，雷区蹦迪，最终被关小黑屋制裁₍ᐢ⸝⸝›̫‹⸝⸝ᐢ₎】

—————分割线—————

萧姚一个激灵，垂死病中惊坐起，闭着眼从床上滚了下去。

她刚才好像真实地经历了一场灭顶之灾。

她被黑袍男人大卸八块，她的母亲抱着她哭得撕心裂肺，一夜白头。

她所在的炼器大宗因为炼了邪器，被批为邪修窝点，一夜之间，被正道给一窝端了，整个山头被夷为平地。

她脑子里的最后一幕，是肢解她的黑袍男人用一面玄色小旗，卷走所有人的魂魄，留下阴诡的桀桀笑声……

萧姚坐在地上，两手发僵地摸摸胳膊揉揉腿，缓了半天才双眼聚焦，重新找回心跳。

她掐了掐自己的脸，只觉得劫后余生。

原来是噩梦。

嗐，自己吓自己。

萧姚擦了擦冷汗，刚把心放回肚里，大脑就猛地一刺，紧接着响起细细的电流声。

【核实目标信息：萧姚，穿越者，炼器宗师独女，神机门大小姐。核实无误，正式绑定。】

【宿主您好，我是您的救世系统，编号025。恭喜……哦不对，宿主节哀，您的死亡通知书已生成，请及时查收。】

萧姚：……查收啥？？？

025又播放了一遍死亡预告。

萧姚双臂在胸前交叉，哪怕心里发毛，嘴上依然找场子：

【不好意思，修仙世界讲究我命由我不由天。】

025呵呵冷笑：

【不，你命由反派。】

萧姚下意识想回嘴，又被眼前加粗标红的倒计时噎了回去。

【宿主存活倒计时：364天23小时。】

萧姚忍不住摸了摸自己的脖子。

025见萧姚终于有所动摇，抓紧时间谆谆善诱：

【宿主，只要你能找到反派，救赎反派，让反派放弃灭世，并且非你不可，你就能活得舒心~】

萧姚在心里叹了口气。

小命是要保住的，她的靠山是不能倒的，但气势是不能弱的，口嗨也是不能停的！

【所以统子，礼貌问问反派的颜值。你是知道的，建模影响动力。】

025哽住了。

你们咸鱼纨绔仙二代的心都这么大的吗？？

【唔……美强惨是反派的标配，所以应该是建模一流的美少年吧。】

萧姚哇凉哇凉的心终于被捂热了。

保命途中顺便撩个美强惨？血赚好吗！

Food guide:

[This is a story about a second-generation dandy who finds the wrong villain and flirts with the wrong villain in front of the villain, stimulating the jealous villain to the point of becoming black.Abbreviation: Take your husband to find a partner (bushi)

[Please enjoy next - Xiao, who has full marks for his rhetoric and zero practical skills, Yao, who plays tricks to death, dances in minefields, and is finally punished by being locked up in a small black room₍ᐢ⸝⸝›̫‹⸝⸝ᐢ₎]

————Dividing line————

Xiao Yao was startled, and he sat up in shock while he was dying. He closed his eyes and rolled off the bed.

She seemed to have experienced a real disaster just now.

She was torn into pieces by men in black robes. Her mother held her and cried heartbrokenly, and her hair turned gray overnight.

The Weapon Refining Sect she belonged to was criticized as a den of evil cultivators because she had refined evil weapons. Overnight, the whole mountain was razed to the ground by the righteous.

The last scene in her mind was the man in black robe who dismembered her and used a small black flag to sweep away everyone's souls, leaving behind a sinister and scornful laughter...

Xiao Yao sat on the ground, touching his arms and legs with stiff hands. It took him a long time to focus his eyes and regain his heartbeat.

She pinched her face, feeling like she was going to survive a disaster.

It turned out to be a nightmare.

Hey, you're scaring yourself.

Xiao Yao wiped his cold sweat and just put his heart back in his stomach when his brain suddenly stabbed, followed by a thin sound of electricity.

[Verify target information: Xiao Yao, a time traveler, the only daughter of the master of weapon refining, and the eldest lady of the Divine Machine Sect.Verified and officially bound.】

[Hello host, I am your salvation system, number 025.Congratulations... Oh no, sorry host, your death notice has been generated, please check it in time.】

Xiao Yao: ...What to check???

025 played the death notice again.

Xiao Yao crossed his arms in front of his chest. Even though he was feeling scared, he still said:

[I'm sorry, the world of cultivating immortals emphasizes that my destiny is up to me and not God.】

025 Hehe sneered:

[No, you are destined to be a villain.】

Xiao Yao subconsciously wanted to reply, but was choked back by the bold and red countdown in front of him.

[Host survival countdown: 364 days and 23 hours.】

Xiao Yao couldn't help but touch his neck.

025 Seeing that Xiao Yao has finally wavered, he seizes the time and seduces:

[Host, as long as you can find the villain, redeem the villain, make the villain give up destroying the world, and you have to do it, you can live comfortably~]

Xiao Yao sighed in his heart.

Her life must be saved, her backer cannot be defeated, but her momentum cannot be weakened, and her oral pleasure cannot stop!

[So Tongzi, politely ask about the villain’s appearance.You know, modeling affects dynamics.】

025 choked.

Do you, the second generation of salty fish and dandy immortals, all have such big hearts??

[Hmm...beautiful and strong is the standard for villains, so he should be a beautiful boy with first-rate modeling.】

Xiao Yao's chilling heart was finally warmed up.

Picking up a pretty girl on the way to save your life?Is it good to make money with blood?
